heading: Thursday, April 10, 2025
topLine: Moonshot AI open-sources Kimi-VL vision-language models.

items.headline: Moonshot AI open-sources Kimi-VL vision-language models
items.summary: Kimi-VL is an MIT-licensed mixture-of-experts vision-language model with 16B total and about 3B active parameters, a 128K context window and the MoonViT native-resolution encoder, released in Instruct and Thinking variants. Moonshot claims state-of-the-art results among open models on OSWorld and long-video and document benchmarks.
